body:
I am presently 24 y/o and taking Adderall to get thru med school.  I was diagnosed with ADD in third grade and have taken Ritalin or Adderall on and off since.  The drugs work wonders.  I focus better, have more energy, can do any task I want and be interested in it.  I even focus on my sport better.  I have noticed the effects become less helpful with longer use.  I dont focus as well w/ a given dose and I actually get less energy.  My heart rate goes up a lot after 5 mg.  I also get w/drawl effects if I stop cold like Im tired, apathetic, lazy.  My heart rate has gone up a lot recently while taking the meds.  Overall, I just try really hard not to become addicted.  I think Im walking a really fine line right now.
